source.name: Simon Fraser University public course outlines API

notes: Ten-course curated Fall 2026 snapshot, not the full SFU catalog or live seat availability.
Each section is a complete lecture plus one linked required LAB/TUT of each listed kind.
Optional OPL workshops are listed in optional_components and excluded from enrollment bundles.
Final exams are included as date-specific EXAM meetings; holidays are not modeled.
Manual prerequisites require advisor verification; no equivalencies or waivers are inferred.

courses.title: Introduction to Computing Science and Programming I
courses.prerequisite_text: BC Math 12 or equivalent is recommended.
courses.restriction_text: Students with credit for CMPT 102, 128, 130 or 166 may not take this course for further credit. Students who have taken CMPT 125, 129, 130 or 135 first may not then take this course for further credit.

courses.title: Introduction to Computing Science and Programming II
courses.prerequisite_text: CMPT 120 or CMPT 130, with a minimum grade of C-.
courses.restriction_text: Students with credit for CMPT 126, 129, 135 or CMPT 200 or higher may not take this course for further credit.

courses.title: Data Structures and Programming
courses.prerequisite_text: (MACM 101 and (CMPT 125, CMPT 129 or CMPT 135)) or (ENSC 251 and ENSC 252), all with a minimum grade of C-.

courses.title: Introduction to Software Engineering

all.manual: One W course with a minimum grade of C- must be verified.

courses.prerequisite_text: One W course, CMPT 225, (MACM 101 or (ENSC 251 and ENSC 252)) and (MATH 151 or MATH 150), all with a minimum grade of C-. MATH 154 or MATH 157 with at least a B+ may be substituted for MATH 151 or MATH 150.
courses.restriction_text: Students with credit for CMPT 275 may not take this course for further credit.

courses.title: Introduction to Computer Systems

all.manual: Applied Physics program membership must be verified.

courses.prerequisite_text: Either (MACM 101 and (CMPT 125 or CMPT 135)) or (MATH 151 and CMPT 102 for students in an Applied Physics program), all with a minimum grade of C-.

courses.title: Discrete Mathematics I

any.manual: BC Pre-Calculus 12, BC Calculus 12, or an accepted equivalent must be verified.

courses.prerequisite_text: BC Pre-Calculus 12 or BC Calculus 12 (or equivalent), or any of MATH 100, 150, 151, 154, 157.

courses.title: Discrete Mathematics II
courses.prerequisite_text: MATH 141 or MACM 101 or (ENSC 251 and one of MATH 232 or MATH 240).

courses.title: Calculus I

any.manual: Pre-Calculus 12 or an accepted equivalent with grade A or higher must be verified.

courses.prerequisite_text: Pre-Calculus 12 (or equivalent) with a grade of at least A, or MATH 100 with a grade of at least B, or MATH 110 with a grade of at least A.
courses.restriction_text: Students with credit for either MATH 150, 154 or 157 may not take MATH 151 for further credit.

courses.title: Calculus II
courses.prerequisite_text: MATH 150 or MATH 151, with a minimum grade of C-; or MATH 154 or MATH 157, with a minimum grade of B.
courses.restriction_text: Students with credit for MATH 155 or MATH 158 may not take this course for further credit.

courses.title: Applied Linear Algebra
courses.prerequisite_text: MATH 150 or 151 or MACM 101, with a minimum grade of C-; or MATH 154 or 157, both with a grade of at least B.
courses.restriction_text: Students with credit for MATH 240 may not take this course for further credit.
